desc: The Frigidaire 30" Single Wall Oven with Fan Convection allows you to achieve faster, more even multi-rack baking results, all in an extra large, 5.3 cu. ft. oven cavity! It also features a premium touch screen digital control panel and provides peace of mind that it will fit existing cutouts with our Frigidaire Fit Promise.
hl: Get faster, more even multi-rack baking results with Fan Convection.
Self clean options available in convenient 2, 3 and 4-hour cycles.

We promise that your new 30" Frigidaire® single wall oven will fit your existing cabinet cutout of the same width and configuration, or we will reimburse you up to $300 for cabinet modification costs.
Features a responsive 4.3 inch, full color, capacitive touch digital control panel.
Cook more at once with our extra large, 5.3 cu. ft. capacity oven.
Allows you to choose the specific broil temperature you want, ranging anywhere between 400 - 550 degrees.
